create_module_subclass: create a python module subclass of Module with Topic class variables and a custom State type
configure_module: configure a Labgraph Module instance by calling configure with a Config object
get_publishers: get all Publisher methods from a Module instance using the publishers property
get_subscribers: get all Subscriber methods from a Module instance using the subscribers property
validate_streams: validate that each stream in a Module has only one publisher by calling _validate_streams
